== Passive Ability: Spellforged Blades ==
Attacks from '''{{PAGENAME}}''' also deal his damage as additional {{Damage Type|Magic}} damage. Buffs to {{Damage Type|Physical}} damage apply to his {{Damage Type|Magic}} damage as well. 

This means he does '''x2 his displayed damage''' 
== Passive Ability: White Flash Draw Technique ==
The first hit against an enemy will have '''+ 100% Critical Chance''' and penetrate '''60%''' of enemy {{Damage Type|Physical}} and {{Damage Type|Magic}} '''Resistances''' (If they have ones)
== Selling ==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
==Trivia==
* Despite stating to penetrate '''60%''' of  {{Damage Type|Physical}} and {{Damage Type|Magic}} '''Resistances''' it has been proven he only penetrates '''40%''' 
* Its possible get a '''Double Crit''' in his first hit ('''x2.5''' instead of '''x1.5''') if you have a base crit chance.
* [[Gambler (Jackpot)]] gives both types of '''Crit Chance''' (magic and physical) to {{PAGENAME}}
** For some reason is impossible to get a '''Double Magic Crit''' despite {{PAGENAME}} having a base magic Crit Chance
* {{PAGENAME}} can be buffed by [[Elfy (Sylph)]] or [[Wind Dragon]] and [[Commander]] '''at the same time''', however, elfy or wind dragon will only buff his {{Damage Type|Magic}} damage.
